item.title: Homes and bridges swept away as fresh floods hit Nepal
item.description: A sudden flash flood in Gorkha district along the Budhi Gandaki River has wreaked havoc, causing severe destruction and displacing many families. With reports of multiple homes and bridges lost, at least ten individuals are currently unaccounted for. In light of the crisis, authorities have deployed rescue teams and helicopters to aid in evacuations. Publicado también por: The Times of India - World. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Trump says Ukraine needs new president who will agree to end war
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Saturday urged Ukraine to replace Volodymyr Zelensky with a new leader, criticising him over strikes on Russian oil refineries that have contributed to high diesel prices ahead of the US midterm elections. Trump told reporters at the White House that he had told Zelensky to "do what you want" against Russia, but "don't hit refineries". "He better damn well stop," Trump said, adding that he believes "it's time for Ukraine to get a new president" who would agree to end the war. We discuss the latest developments with our guest, Pyotr Kurzin, host of The Global… Publicado también por: BBC News - World. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: 'Cockroach Party' protesters vow to return after hundreds detained in Delhi
item.description: Chaos erupts in India's capital New Delhi as police detained hundreds of protesters during demonstrations over the Election Commission's move to drop some 130 million names from the voter list. Publicado también por: BBC News - World. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
